dedupe_keys.name: cnic list of main accidents and failures at nuclear power plants and fuel cycle facilities in japan fiscal year 2023

description: This article from the Citizens' Nuclear Information Center in Japan lists the main accidents and failures at Japanese nuclear power plants and fuel cycle facilities in fiscal year 2023, published on 2 October 2024 from issue 604 of the centre's newsletter. The list is built from the NUCIA nuclear facility information disclosure library and operators' press releases and reports, keeping the cases that NUCIA classes as T (trouble information, 6 cases) and M (maintenance information, 57 cases); troubles at several Kansai Electric units on 20 April are grouped as one entry. The author also singles out the 4 October outage of all ventilation fans at the Rokkasho high-level waste management centre as a serious event. Access: free to read on the CNIC site, in Japanese, with the table on the page and a downloadable file offered; no licence is stated. Coverage is Japan for one fiscal year. Caveats: the selection is by an advocacy organisation from NUCIA classes, so it is not a full regulatory event database. It suits studies of nuclear plant reliability and incident analysis, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
